overviewDescription: Choose a child to view care, details and contacts.

careEnded.title: Care has ended
careEnded.body: Your child is no longer in care at this {careTerm}. You can still view everything from before. New reports are no longer possible.

withoutCarePlace.title: No place in the {careTerm}
withoutCarePlace.body: Your child does not have a place in the {careTerm}. Pickup, care times, meals and messages to the {careTerm} are therefore not available here.

notFound: There is no child at this address in your account. Please choose your child from the overview.
noChildren: No child is linked to your account yet. Your school's {careTerm} can set this up.

care.title: Care & weekly plan
care.description: Bookings, regular pick-up times and the journey home.

data.title: Child details
data.description: Personal details, class and health information.

contacts.title: Contacts & pick-up
contacts.description: Guardians, pick-up permissions and app access.

today.pickupChanged: Pick-up today at {time}, changed for today
today.pickupNone: No pick-up is recorded for today
today.pickupUnknown: The pick-up time is not available right now

consents.title: Consents and confirmations
consents.description: Here you can see your child's consents.
consents.staffDescription: Parents change photo consent in the parent portal. Parents without the portal tell you. Then remove the tick under “Bearbeiten” at the photo.
consents.photoDescription: You can change photo consent here.
consents.photoViaCareDescription: To withdraw photo consent, contact the {careTerm}.
consents.confirmBody: The consent ends immediately. If a photo is stored, it will be deleted.
consents.success: Photo consent was withdrawn. If a photo was stored, it was deleted.
consents.grantConfirmBody: The {careTerm} may store a photo again afterwards.
consents.withdrawTooltip: Ends the photo consent and deletes a stored photo. moto asks first.
consents.grantTooltip: Lets the {careTerm} store a photo again. moto asks first.
consents.roomHistoryDescription: You can stop the room history and mood here.
consents.roomHistoryStopTooltip: Deletes the room history so far and stops recording. moto asks first.
consents.roomHistoryStopBody: moto immediately deletes which rooms your child was in. After that, moto no longer saves your child's rooms or mood. The care staff can still see where your child is right now.
consents.roomHistoryStopSuccess: Room history and mood are stopped. The room history so far has been deleted.
consents.roomHistoryResumeAria: Save room history and mood again
consents.roomHistoryResumeTooltip: moto saves rooms and mood again from now on. moto asks first.
consents.roomHistoryResumeTitle: Save room history and mood again?
consents.roomHistoryResumeBody: From now on, moto saves again which rooms your child is in and how your child is feeling. Deleted data does not come back.
consents.roomHistoryResumeSuccess: moto saves room history and mood again from now on.
